scope: Read-only review; no Current source, runtime, code, or Git changes.
human_decision_preserved: Runtime has four narrower kinds: Internal Local Runtime, Internal Remote Runtime, External Local Runtime and External Remote Runtime. Internal/external refers to our application. Local is on the Operator’s machine; Remote is elsewhere. Session is NARROWER_THAN External Remote Runtime. Retain Execution with Workflow Run, Step Run and Action Run, plus Event.

aligned.finding: The 11 candidate kinds match the latest explicit inventory. Workflow Run, Step Run and Action Run narrow to Execution; Execution, Runtime and Event narrow to Occurrent; four named Runtime kinds narrow to Runtime; Session narrows to External Remote Runtime.

Session as a subtype of External Remote Runtime follows the latest human decision. It asserts no containment or separate typed Runtime–Session Relation. Do not use the old slash path as evidence for this chosen parent.

Formal Claim narrowing expressions use current CFEL syntax. The general Node model NARROWER_THAN and HAS_NARROWER permissions can inherit to these Nodes under current Relation-cardinality rules; no additional hierarchy relation or subtype-specific taxonomy permission is needed.
Workflow Run to Workflow uses current IS_EXECUTION_OF endpoints; the exact-one binding is supported by archived CA-R-1510@18. No actual run or other instance field is proposed.

The four Runtime labels and Semantics match the explicit criteria: Internal/External means of our application vs outside it; Local means on the Operator’s machine and Remote means elsewhere. No concrete Runtime instances are inferred.

blocking_findings.finding: The Step Run and Action Run Semantics say each is an execution of one Step or Action, but Current CA-R-2245 scopes IS_EXECUTION_OF to Workflow Run -> Workflow. Do not apply that relation to Step/Action endpoints as written. Either add separately named relation definitions and inverse counterparts or review a scoped extension of the existing endpoint signature; do not silently broaden it.
required_review: Step Run -> Step and inverse counterpart
Action Run -> Action and inverse counterpart

blocking_findings.finding: Current Node instance wildcard defaults outgoing relations to zero. CA-R-2588 requires each intended direction to have an applicable named permission; derived inverse does not itself grant permission. The Workflow Run binding in its preview supplies the forward :1 constraint, but the Workflow HAS_EXECUTION view needs its own outgoing permission. Any Runtime EXECUTES Workflow Run or Event Record RECORDS Event use likewise needs permissions scoped to both endpoints/directions.
